## Activity

During January 2020, River Outreach recorded 37 captures. This represents the complete activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading review. The activity level is documented here for operational monitoring and comparison with the site’s review outcomes. No additional activity figures are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 37 captures, 4 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 10.8 per cent of captures. These images could not proceed through grading and are therefore reported separately from the gradable work. The result is retained as an operational quality measure for River Outreach and should be considered alongside the grading outcome below.

## Grading

A total of 1 capture was graded referable. The median grading lag was 0 days, indicating that the reported median wait for grading was 0. Together, the grading result and the image-quality measure provide a concise view of the month’s completed review activity. Staff reported no new equipment faults during January 2020.
